questions.q_en: If 12th February 1932 was Friday, then what day of a week will fall on 12th February 2025?
questions.solution_en:
12th February 1932 was Friday.

Period starting from 12th February 1932 to 12th February 2025, there were 94 years.

If we divide 94 by 4 (because leap year occurs in every 4 years), then the quotient will be 23.

So, from period of 12th February 1932 to 12th February 2025, there were 23 leap years and 71 normal years.

We know that, there are 2 odd days in a leap year and 1 odd day in a normal year. Thus, 23 * 2 + 71 * 1 = 46 + 71 = 117 odd days.

If we divide, 117 by 7, then remainder will be 5. So, 5 odd days.

So, 12th February 2025 = Friday + 5 days = Wednesday.

12th February 1932 was Friday.

If we divide, 117 by 7, then remainder will be 5. So, 5 odd days.

So, 12th February 2025 = Friday + 5 days = Wednesday.

questions.q_en: A is 15 ranks ahead of B in a class of 32. If B's rank is 7th from the last, what is A's rank from the top?

Given that A is 15 ranks ahead of B and B's rank is 7th from the last.

Hence, A ranks is = (15 + 7) = 22nd from the last.

Therefore, the rank of A from the top is = 32 - 22 + 1 = 11th
